aboutAuthorBio: Hi, I'm Nicu - I designed and built gn33 shop end to end, from the database up to the storefront.
aboutAuthorInvite: It's a fully working demo: browse the catalogue, place a test order, or look around the admin back office.
aboutProjectTitle: A demo, not a real shop
aboutProjectBody: gn33 shop is a demo project, not a real business - a full-stack portfolio piece built to showcase production-grade engineering, modelled as an online store for handmade knitted dolls, pins and craft goods. It has a real cart, guest checkout and a staff back office, but no real orders are fulfilled and no real payments are taken.
